args.evidence: The not_null_fct_orders_region_name test failed with 14625 null region_name values. In fct_orders the join to dim_customers incorrectly used o.order_key = c.customer_key, causing mismatched rows and null region_name. Changing the join condition to o.customer_key = c.customer_key correctly links each order to its customer, restoring region_name values. After applying this patch, all tests pass.
